comment: Reviewed canonical (--turns 1000) scale baseline, one section per platform. Written ONLY by an explicit `node scripts/edition8/scale-probe.mjs --turns 1000 --write-baseline` run and committed after review; the comparing run (CI or local) never writes this file and fails loudly when it is missing, unparsable or a tracked metric regresses beyond the policy below.

policy.comment: Per-metric multiplier/floor calibrated from two canonical runs on this platform (calibration note in the BASELINE_POLICY block of scripts/edition8/scale-probe.mjs); a regressed metric must exceed BOTH baseline x multiplier AND baseline + floor.

turns-compaction.turn_curve.reason: decile-median turn latency ratio; observed 1.06x across two canonical runs, floor 1.0 covers warmup jitter, absolute assert <=20 is the hard ceiling

turns-compaction.turn_steady_curve.reason: first-vs-last decile steady plateau; observed 0.90x across runs, absolute assert <=2 remains the effective ceiling

turns-compaction.compaction_ms_per_ktok_.reason: compaction ms/1k-token shape on a sub-1 baseline; observed delta +0.89 under the post-turn writer storm, floor 1.0 covers it while absolute assert <=3 stays tighter

transcript-100k-page-search.page_curve_f.reason: page latency shape on a 0.5 baseline; observed 1.58x swing from sub-ms denominator noise, floor 0.75 covers it, absolute assert <=6 is the ceiling

transcript-100k-page-search.search_ratio.reason: 100k-vs-10k search scaling ratio; observed 1.16x across runs, floor 1.0 absorbs sub-ms denominator jitter, absolute assert <=25 is the ceiling

memory-5000.create_curve_first_last.reason: memory create shape over sub-ms first-decile medians; observed delta +1.78 under load, floor 2.0 covers it, absolute assert <=8 is the ceiling

history-2000.page_curve_first_last.reason: history paging shape on sub-ms pages; observed 0.63-1.58x across runs, floor 0.75 absorbs denominator jitter, absolute assert <=6 is the ceiling

turns-compaction.turn_ms.p95.reason: absolute turn p95 under the real provider loop; observed 326-455ms across four canonical runs, x3+100ms covers the storm band while a 10x algorithmic regression still fails

turns-compaction.compaction_ms.p95.reason: absolute compaction p95; observed 43-56ms across runs, x3+50ms covers the band while an algorithmic regression still fails

transcript-100k-page-search.page_ms.p95.reason: absolute page p95 over 100k messages; observed 2-10ms across runs, x3+15ms covers scheduler jitter, a full-scan page still fails

transcript-100k-page-search.search_100k_.reason: absolute search p50 on 100k messages; observed 151-226ms across runs, x3+100ms covers the storm band while a full-scan regression fails

transcript-100k-page-search.search_10k_m.reason: absolute search p50 on 10k messages; observed 15-34ms across runs, x3+25ms covers the band

memory-5000.create_ms.p95.reason: absolute memory create p95; observed 3.1-13.9ms across runs (storm-driven p95 tail), x3+20ms covers the observed band while a policy/scan regression still fails

memory-5000.edit_ms.p95.reason: absolute memory edit p95; observed 2.9-4.6ms across runs, x3+5ms covers sub-ms jitter

memory-5000.delete_ms.p95.reason: absolute memory delete p95; observed 2.1-2.4ms across runs, x3+5ms covers sub-ms jitter

history-2000.page_ms.p95.reason: absolute history page p95 on sub-ms pages; observed 0.67-0.96ms across runs, x3+2ms keeps the bound tight so a constant-factor page regression fails

child-agents-500.agents_ms.reason: absolute 500-child projection read; observed 14-24.4ms across runs, x3+20ms covers the band while an unbounded projection regression fails

proof-10000-claims.proof_ms.reason: absolute 10k-claim proof read; observed 8.2-9.1ms across runs, x3+10ms covers the band

concurrent-16-stream.prompt_ms.p95.reason: absolute prompt-accept p95 across 16 live streams; observed 48-90ms across runs, x3+50ms covers scheduler load while an admission-path regression fails

mcp-skills-hooks-500.mcp_save_ms.p50.reason: median MCP save (p95 over 8 samples is max-like: one slow or lock-retried sample dominates it); sub-ms when clean, 10ms floor fails a CRUD path degraded into scan territory

mcp-skills-hooks-500.hook_save_ms.p50.reason: median hook save (p95 over 256 samples tracked the lock-shim tail in observed runs); sub-ms when clean, 10ms floor fails a CRUD path degraded into scan territory

rss-bounded.start_kb.reason: daemon RSS before the workload; observed 0.99x across runs, allocator jitter is tens of percent

rss-bounded.peak_kb.reason: daemon RSS peak holding 100k messages/5k facts/10k claims; observed 1.05x across runs, a retained-buffer regression is hundreds of MiB

rss-bounded.end_kb.reason: daemon RSS after the workload; observed 1.05x across runs, a retained-buffer regression is hundreds of MiB
